messages:
leah (AE): HarborTech wants a compact proof-of-performance for a mixed workload: chat at sustained 150 qps (512 seq), embeddings pipeline at 50 qps, and microbursts up to 900 qps for chat. They need a short writeup, cost delta between redwood-7b-fp32 and redwood-7b-4bit, and CI commands to reproduce. Can we confirm scope?

marc (SRE): Confirmed. Proposed schedule: 15m warm, 30m steady (chat 150qps + embeddings 50qps), bursts: 3m@300, 3m@600, 5m@900, then 10m cooldown. We'll capture p50/p95/p99/p99.9 per route, embedding latency hist, GPU slice util, batch size dist, and kv cache hit rate. Tag runs customer=harbortech bench=mixedworkload.

nina (SE): Important: embeddings have different perf profile; keep separate routing and metrics so we can show tail by route. Also suggest testing model combos: redwood-7b-fp32 for chat + redwood-1b-4bit for embeddings (if they want cheaper embedding tier).

owen (Solutions Eng): Cost quick take: chat tokens dominate. Assuming 90 tok/resp for chat and 768 tok/embedding request (avg), steady token rates: chat 150*90=13.5k tok/s, embeddings 50*768=38.4k tok/s => embeddings actually dominate token volume in this scenario. Need to call this out in the writeup because it flips expected cost.

marc (SRE): Bench profile (short):
```
models: [redwood-7b-fp32(chat), redwood-1b-4bit(embeddings), redwood-7b-4bit(chat-alt)]
seq_chat: 512
seq_embed: 768
qps: {chat: [steady:150, bursts:300,600,900], embeds: steady:50}
batching: chat_fp32 target 16, chat_4bit target 8, embed_4bit target 32
warmup: populate chat prefix cache with 10k prompts
metrics: per-route latency_histogram_ms, token/sec, gpu_util_pct, batch_size_hist
```

leah (AE): CI command we can paste to them? They want the exact command used in CI.

marc (SRE): Pasteable run example:
```
./ci/bench_runner \
  --profile profiles/harbortech_mixed.json \
  --out gs://redwood-temp/harbortech/mixed-final.json \
  --meta "customer=harbortech,run=mixedproof" \
  --redact-prompts true \
  --duration 4200
```
Redact flag hashes prompts and stores hashes+token counts only.

nina (SE): Security note: if they require HSM-backed KMS we recommend Dedicated or Private; hosted run artifacts live in encrypted buckets with 14 day retention by default. We'll provide deletion logs on request.

owen (Solutions Eng): Pricing appendix: quick numbers based on this run (example list-rate): chat fp32 token cost $0.0000010/token, chat 4bit $0.00000036/token, embed 1b-4bit $0.00000010/token. Because embeddings volume is high here, total cost skews to embedding tier despite chat's higher per-token price. I'll prepare a short spreadsheet.

infra-bot: bench job harbortech-mixed-v2 queued on runner-us-central (id: infra-hrb-2024-08-09)

marc (SRE): interim: steady-state complete (30m). Chat 7b-4bit steady p95 140ms, p99 360ms, p99.9 740ms. Embeddings (1b-4bit) steady p95 35ms, p99 90ms, p99.9 210ms. No dropped requests, gpu util averages 68% across slices. Uploading partial artifacts to gs://redwood-temp/harbortech/partial/

leah (AE): Good. Can you run the fp32 chat baseline next? Customer cares about tail at high burst.

marc (SRE): Running fp32 chat now. Will run same bursts.

infra-bot: quota bump applied for temporary burst capacity for harbortech-mixed-v2

marc (SRE): final: all runs complete. Topline summary:
- chat redwood-7b-4bit: steady p95 145ms, burst@900 p95 560ms, burst@900 p99.9 1.4s
- chat redwood-7b-fp32: steady p95 100ms, burst@900 p95 260ms, burst@900 p99.9 780ms
- embed redwood-1b-4bit: steady p95 36ms, burst noise minimal, p99.9 220ms
Observed cost across full run: embeddings accounted for ~62% of token volume and ~48% of cost (because embed token count per req high but per-token price low). Overall fp32 chat baseline increased total cost by ~2.9x vs all-4bit setup.

nina (SE): Recommendation: For HarborTech, hybrid approach: use 1b-4bit for embeddings (cheap and low tail), use fp32 for chat if they need tight burst tail SLAs; otherwise 7b-4bit is fine for steady traffic. Suggest routing policy: prefer fp32 during predicted bursts and fall back to 4bit if capacity constrained.

owen (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the cost appendix and three pricing scenarios (hosted list-rate, hosted with 30% commit discount, Dedicated monthly commit).

leah (AE): Who can own the one-pager? Need it for customer meeting Thurs afternoon.

nina (SE): I'll draft the one-pager + short 3-slide deck (TL;DR, heatmaps, recommendation). Will include links to run profiles and redact manifest. ETA Wed EOD.

marc (SRE): Artifacts uploaded and permissions set: gs://redwood-temp/harbortech/final/; redact manifest included. Closing thread once deck is in.

leah (AE): Thanks team! Action items: marc upload final logs (done), nina draft writeup (owner), owen finalize cost appendix, leah prep customer invite. :rocket:
